name: nes15 (the Fifteen Puzzle)

memory.source: the game's own source, src/play.s (play_state, play_flags, enum PLAY_*); the addresses measured in BizHawk 2.11.1 on 2026-09-23: after Start play_state reads 1, and the game's auto-solver takes it to 3 with SOLVED! on screen

goal: Solve the puzzle: put the tiles in order 1 to 15 with the gap in the bottom right corner.
controls: D-pad moves the cursor, A slides the tile under the cursor into the gap, Start pauses, Select toggles the game's auto-solver. At the title screen any button starts a puzzle.

bot.about: The mock plays with the game's own auto-solver: let the title screen come up, start a puzzle, press Select, wait for SOLVED. The timings are the ones measured in BizHawk 2.11.1 on 2026-09-23 (a button in the first frames after power-on is not taken; the title then starts on the next button).
